A literary device , literary technique , figure of speech , rhetorical device , stylistic device ,  or trope is any deliberate strategy of using language that a writer or speaker employs to more effectively achieve some purpose. This purpose may be: to focus or guide the audience's attention, to make the language or its content memorable, or to evoke a particular emotional, rational, aesthetic, or other response. [ 1 ] The many names (or synonyms ) for this concept may carry slightly distinct meanings in technical scholarly usage.
